entities.summary: Sem Verbeek is a Dutch tennis player who specializes in doubles. He has a career high ATP doubles ranking of World No. 29 achieved on 19 May 2025. In 2025, Verbeek won the mixed doubles title at Wimbledon with Kateřina Siniaková. He is the current No. 5 Dutch doubles player. He also has a career-high in singles of No. 531 achieved on 15 April 2019. Sem Verbeek was a athletes & competitors from Amsterdam (b. 1994-04-12, Amsterdam). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
